svg.data-weight-note: 14.36 kg (31.65 lb) fully loaded without optics (guide Table 10)
svg.data-power-measurement-note: Typical and maximum power consumption of the QFX5241-32OD AC switch, guide Power System section; the guide gives no test conditions. Table 15 prints 537 W and 1381 W for the same switch.
svg.data-power-input-ac: 200 to 240 VAC at 15 A, or 100 to 127 VAC at 12 A with 1000 W output, 50 to 60 Hz (guide Table 6)
svg.data-redundancy-note: two supplies, 1+1 on the 200 to 240 VAC range only, hot-removable and hot-insertable (guide, Component Redundancy)
svg.data-fans: seven fan modules of two rotors, N+1; front-to-back only
svg.data-airflow-note: AO is front-to-back (port-to-FRU, airflow out); the guide describes no back-to-front module
svg.data-storage-temp: -40 to 70 C (-40 to 158 F) in the shipping container
svg.data-altitude: no performance degradation to 1828.8 m (6000 ft) at 0 to 40 C with DAC cables; sea level with optics (guide Table 22)
svg.data-cpu: Intel Ice Lake D, 4 cores, 2.2 GHz
svg.data-optics-osfp: 800 GbE OSFP, with linear pluggable optics (LPO) support (guide, System Overview)
svg.data-optics-sfp28: two SFP28 ports, 10 GbE in the guide and 25G on the plate
svg.data-nebs: designed to comply with Zone 4 earthquake requirements of NEBS GR-63-CORE, Issue 5 (guide Table 22)
